entries.5bfdb2940124974d: This business is carried out by subsidiary Kuraray Trading Co., Ltd., which processes and sells synthetic fibers and artificial leather, and also plans and sells products of the company's group and of other companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥67,343 million. In textiles, sports and outdoor apparel applications were strong; in resins and chemical products, sales of resins and processed products expanded, centered on Asian markets.
entries.7b81e4ff730d70b7: It is a business that produces and sells vinylon, artificial leather Clarino, hook-and-loop fastener Magic Tape, polyester, and other products. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥56,265 million. For artificial leather, new adoption in footwear applications had an effect, while weak demand in Europe and production adjustments at EV makers caused sales volume to decline, mainly in luxury and automotive applications. Sales of the liquid crystal polymer fiber Vectran also progressed.

entries.8dbef0f31c5d4843: This business manufactures and sells functional resins and films, including Poval resin and film, ＰＶＢ resin and film, and ＥＶＯＨ resin (EVAL), and is the reportable segment with the largest revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥387,169 million. The MD&A states that sales volume did not increase as much as expected due to the stagnation of the European economy. Sales volume of water-soluble Poval film increased on rising demand for individually packaged detergents, and sales volume of optical Poval film increased due to measures supporting appliance replacement in China, among others.
entries.b4994d14a6d61b5d: It is a category designated as a "business segment not included in reportable segments" and includes the Engineering Business and others.
entries.bdf0ce3fc3c67775: It produces and sells thermoplastic elastomer Septon, isoprene-based chemicals, and heat-resistant polyamide resin Genestar. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥61,057 million. With its Thailand site operating stably, it pushed to expand sales. Sales volume of Genestar increased in electrical and electronics and automotive applications, while demand for isoprene chemicals fell from the third quarter onward due to weak demand for construction applications in China, among other factors.
entries.cad555bb2bb5e10a: This business manufactures and sells methacrylic resins, medical-related products (dental materials), activated carbon, water treatment products and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥202,208 million. Dental materials for aesthetic treatment performed well, centered on Europe and the United States. Sales volume of activated carbon increased, centered on drinking water applications, but some customers reviewed their purchase timing due to U.S. tariff policies and others, and volume did not reach the expected level. Production capacity for methyl methacrylate and others has been reduced since July 2025.
